About 2½ cups

Two and a half cups of flour is typical for a batch of chocolate chip cookies or a sandwich loaf.

A cup measures volume, so 2½ cups weighs a different amount for every ingredient. Dense ingredients like honey and peanut butter weigh far more than light ones like oats and cocoa. For dry ingredients the numbers here assume the cup is spooned in and leveled; brown sugar is packed.

Questions

How many grams is 2½ cups of all-purpose flour?

2½ cups of all-purpose flour weighs about 300 g (10.6 oz), based on 120 g per cup.

How many grams is 2½ cups of granulated sugar?

2½ cups of granulated sugar weighs about 500 g (17.6 oz), based on 200 g per cup.

How many grams is 2½ cups of butter?

2½ cups of butter weighs about 567 g (20 oz), based on 227 g per cup.
